text:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Deploy start: release=v2026-03-21 slot=09:00UTC canary=5% — initiating canary rollout.
prod-monitor-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx from eu-west-1 model-serving; error-rate +7% in last 1m. link: https://monitoring.example/alerts/1234 :rotating_light:
marta: seeing the same, UX complaints up. i'm pausing any further warmups. @sam can you pause deploy?
sam: pausing now — `/deploybot pause 1734567890`
deploy-bot: Paused by @sam. Canary progression halted. State=PAUSED
marta: recommend pinning traffic to previous stable commit v2026-03-18-hotfix to avoid auto-rollforward.
ops-lead: agree. Will apply pinlist change and set fallback policy. @jen please prep rollback notes.
jen: on it. will update release_notes.md and add the rollback checklist. snippet:
```
Rollback checklist:
- set traffic to v2026-03-18-hotfix
- revert config change X
- monitor 5xx <= 0.5% for 10m
```
oncall: investigating autoscaler and nginx 502 traces in eu-west. suspect CVM OOMs on a subset of hosts.
sam: ops-lead — can you set deploy safety-net: fallback after 3 consecutive 5xx minutes?
ops-lead: set safety-net rule → fallback_on_error=3m, fallback_target=v2026-03-18-hotfix. done.
marta: propose reschedule: bump slot +2h (11:00UTC), reduce initial canary to 1% and run a 15m smoke before ramp.
sam: sounds good. I'll request the reschedule.
sam: `/deploybot reschedule 1734567890 new_slot=11:00UTC initial_canary=1% preflight=15m`
deploy-bot: Reschedule requested by @sam. New_slot=11:00UTC initial_canary=1% preflight=15m. Awaiting ops approval.
ops-lead: approved. updating calendar and the pinlist. Ping if any change :thumbsup: 
jen: release notes updated with incident blurb and rollback steps. will circulate to CS & SRE.
marta: thanks — once autoscaler fix validated we can resume. keeping this thread for coordination. :white_check_mark:
